name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 49 - Am 127
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 49 a. Calls for thorough examination of all Union loans and subsidies to green transition projects, such as Northvolt; urges immediate action to limit taxpayer losses from green transition projects;
